title: 100 Hours Doomsday
description: This is the Doomsday add-on for the 100 Hours SMP Datapack
body:
This is the doomsday add-on for 100 Hours SMP.

This datapack adds a add-on for the [100 Hours SMP (Season One)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/100-hours-smp) Datapack. Once a player reachs 100 hours this datapack will take over and change the way the server runs!

Players may regen health again, the timer is still here, and all players will start as alive, but once someone dies they become a Reaper! The Reaper's Time gose backward at 5x speed and the only way to fix your timer is to kill someone, becoming alive again!
